newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHEARER SCORES ON RETURN AS NEWCASTLE DRAW AT CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEARER SCORES ON RETURN AS NEWCASTLE DRAW AT CHELSEA.

text.p: Gianfranco Zola might have scored on his English premier league home debut and Alan Shearer definitely equalised on his return from injury as Chelsea shared a 1-1 draw with Newcastle on Saturday.
Chelsea's goal came from a Zola free-kick although fellow-Italian Gianluca Vialli claimed the final touch and his seventh goal of the season.
Newcastle's goal came from a fine shot on the turn from Shearer just before the interval.
Fourth-placed Wimbledon also eked out a 1-1 scoreline at Liverpool despite falling behind after just 40 seconds to a goal from Stan Collymore, starting his first match since October 12.
Champions Manchester United had to settle for a single point too after Middlesbrough twice fought back from a goal down to earn a 2-2 draw at the Riverside stadium.
